banner.practice: Your turn! Press the green key.
banner.complete: Great job! You finished the song.

billieJean.description: Michael Jackson — F#m groove + chorus + keyboard section.

jingleBells.description: Classic holiday melody — 2 verses + 2 choruses in F major.

odeToJoy.description: Beethoven's famous theme — calm and steady.

furElise.description: Beethoven — the famous opening theme, A minor.

riverFlowsInYou.description: Yiruma — flowing arpeggio theme, A major.

canonInD.description: Pachelbel — rising variations over the famous chord progression.

someoneLikeYou.description: Adele — verse + chorus hook, A major.

shapeOfYou.description: Ed Sheeran — the iconic marimba riff.

mesafe.description: Serdar Ortaç — verse + «Hiç yüzünden…» hook + chorus (kolaynota).

simarik.description: Tarkan — intro riff + verse + «Seni gidi…» + ocağına (PDF).

olsun.description: Sertab Erener — intro + «Ben giderim… olsun» (kolaynota, F#m).

ayaBenzer.description: Mustafa Sandal — intro + «Aya benzer yüreğim…» (kolaynota, Am).

turkMarsi.description: Mozart — Rondo Alla Turca / Turkish March (kolaynota, Am).
